findings.evidence: MAUD question asks the superior-offer COR standard. The accepted supporting quote explicitly invokes Notice of Intervening Event. Both the claim and whole-answer checks incorrectly accepted the condition mismatch. Schema enforcement alone does not fix this semantic failure.

All seven remaining controls failed JSON parsing. Error-driven keep=false does not count as a calibrated negative decision. V1 did not persist raw failed completion bodies, so the exact output format is unknown until a separately logged reproduction.

Saved sentence decisions split at U.S. into incomplete fragments, including Social Security office, U.S. and Embassy, or consulate. Whole-answer review avoids this particular segmentation failure without changing the trace.

The reviewer added an apostrophe to source Board s in its quote; conservative quote matching rejected it. Preserve source bytes and record raw outputs rather than silently relaxing semantic quotation checks.
